scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
